glosses: to right, to straighten (to make straight)
to make something stand or hang straight
to remove wrinkles or bumps from something
to explain, to make clear, to straighten (to clarify a situation or concept to someone)
to straighten up (to become straight or straighter)
to be made clear, to get explained

examples.text: Generał w zamyśleniu przeszedł obok rzędów wyprostowanych żołnierzy.
